design: PPO Order Fulfilment & Customer Delivery r01
browser_binary_note: Playwright does not report the binary a channel resolved to. Where the environment aliases the chrome channel to the bundled Chromium, browser_version equals the bundled version and this run is a Chromium run, not a Google Chrome run.

results.name: Five connected views render with their scope identifiers and the central question
The register shows source order, account, purchase order, handover and three separate dates
Search, filters and the empty state explain themselves and clear cleanly
A snapshot card opens the exact contributing records and preserves filter context
Coordination views are labelled as PPO views, not source statuses
The order drawer separates acceptance, Won, ERP order creation and receiving responsibility
Stock shows unknown, quarantined, unresolved-unit and anomalous observations as themselves
An incomplete observation cannot be reserved from the interface
Reserving binds evidenced usable stock and refuses a second allocation of the same quantity
A competing order can take only the remaining evidenced quantity
Picking and staging are separate physical observations recorded by the warehouse role
Dispatch preparation records the receiving point and moves nothing
Issuing a pick list does not dispatch the goods
Physical dispatch and the source shipment outcome are recorded separately
Delivery capture records the actual receiving point and keeps the use area separate
An acknowledgement names its exact delivery and excludes wider acceptance
The remaining four units stay outstanding and become an owned exception
The same impact identity cannot create a second follow-up obligation
A later confirmed receipt is a refreshed observation, then the second shipment completes the line
The original shortage and both shipments remain visible after completion
A correction supersedes its predecessor and retains the original capture
A lost response blocks further effect and the original operation recovers without duplication
A simulated save failure records nothing and retains the entries
Partial, failed and empty source scenarios explain themselves without showing zero
Company and identity switching isolates records without mixing them
Restricted commercial values never reach a non-commercial role anywhere on the page
A read-only identity can inspect everything and record nothing
Reload restores the exact saved records, context and filters
A damaged saved session preserves the original content and offers an export
Keyboard navigation reaches the views and opens a record without a pointer
Every view renders at 1440, 1024, 820, 390 and 320 px with no horizontal page overflow
The phone picking and delivery forms present full-width controls with large targets
